title: Crypt of the Blood Jewel
description: After breaking into a long-lost crypt, treasure hunter Kieren finally finds the legendary Blood Jewel. But a single drop of blood awakens something that has been waiting in the darkness.
excerpt: Kieren has finally found the legendary Blood Jewel hidden deep within an ancient crypt. But when his blood touches the jewel, the treasure's towering guardian awakens.
author: from-a-storyteller
